items.title: Heathrow and Other European Airports Hit by Cyberattack, Several Flights Delayed
items.description: A major cyberattack on a popular aviation software provider has caused significant disruptions at key European airports, including London’s Heathrow, Brussels, and Berlin, resulting in hundreds of flight delays and cancellations on Saturday. items.title: First-ever AI-powered ‘MalTerminal’ Malware Uses OpenAI GPT-4 to Generate Ransomware Code
items.description: AI-powered malware, known as ‘MalTerminal’, uses OpenAI’s GPT-4 model to dynamically generate malicious code, including ransomware and reverse shells, marking a significant shift in how threats are developed and deployed. items.title: Top Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild in 2025

items.title: LastPass Warns of Fake Repositories Infecting macOS with Atomic Infostealer
